title: Fog above Alder Pass
body: Visibility dropped after the second switchback; orange markers remained easy to follow.
author: Mira Chen

title: Bridge plank repair
body: The west plank is new and firm, but the approach is muddy after rain.
author: Jon Bell

title: Night chorus near the marsh
body: Tree frogs began calling shortly after sunset beside the northern boardwalk.
author: Sam Okafor

title: Granite Ridge water stop
body: The spring is flowing slowly; carry extra water on warm afternoons.
author: Mira Chen

title: Blue gentian bloom
body: A dense patch is flowering below the east lookout without encroaching on the path.
author: Leah Ortiz

title: Quiet campsite 7
body: Fire ring was cold and the bear locker latched correctly during inspection.
author: Jon Bell

title: Fox tracks at dawn
body: Fresh tracks crossed the sandy bend toward the cedar grove.
author: Sam Okafor

title: South spur wayfinding
body: The lower junction sign points correctly, though its paint is fading.
author: Leah Ortiz

title: After-rain creek level
body: Water reached the second gauge stripe but stayed below the stepping stones.
author: Mira Chen

title: Cedar Grove shade
body: The grove remained cool at midday; the north bench needs a new slat.
author: Jon Bell

title: Owl call by the quarry
body: Two barred owl calls were heard from separate slopes around 21:10.
author: Sam Okafor

title: Lookout rail check
body: All bolts were tight; light surface rust is visible on the southeast corner.
author: Leah Ortiz

title: Windfall cleared
body: A small pine was moved from the upper lake connector before noon.
author: Mira Chen

title: Heron at Reed Pond
body: One great blue heron fed along the western reeds for about twenty minutes.
author: Jon Bell

title: Loose gravel on Quarry Cut
body: The steep inside turn is loose enough to warrant slower downhill travel.
author: Sam Okafor

title: Morning rain at Pine Gate
body: Brief rain left the stone entrance slick; drainage channels stayed open.
author: Leah Ortiz

title: Blackberry edge growth
body: Canes extend into the path near kilometer three and should be trimmed.
author: Mira Chen

title: Lake loop sunset
body: The west shore stayed clear and reflected a bright copper sky.
author: Jon Bell

title: Boardwalk grip test
body: New mesh strips held well when wet across all twelve marsh panels.
author: Sam Okafor

title: Alder Pass marker count
body: All fourteen orange trail markers are present from the gate to the saddle.
author: Leah Ortiz

title: Dry basin refill
body: The emergency water cache contains six sealed bottles with current dates.
author: Mira Chen

title: Moss on north steps
body: Green moss covers the shaded edges but the center tread remains clear.
author: Jon Bell

title: Swallowtail survey
body: Five yellow swallowtails visited the meadow asters in ten minutes.
author: Sam Okafor

title: East meadow gate
body: Latch closes fully after adjustment and the hinge no longer drags.
author: Leah Ortiz
